application: Required reviewed policy intent for cutover; not a native mutation payload and not applied by importing the successor tasks alone. Reconcile against current canonical invariant IDs through supported authority operations.

amendments.subject: ownership
amendments.replacement_intent: Baseplane owns sequence meaning, exact grounding, provenance and sequence-specific representation/routing questions. Cellerator owns shared numerical/ABI/planning capabilities AND experimental learned mechanisms or ML-like math from inception, including parameterized operators, local learning fixtures and unqualified kernels. Extend isolated research scopes in both repositories. Use independent owning tasks; do not create a second numerical owner in Baseplane or wait for qualification before placing research in Cellerator.

amendments.subject: non-goals
amendments.replacement_intent: Do not carry the blanket no-learning/no-interpreter restriction into isolated experiments. Permit small toy trainers, finite-state interpreters, persistent/cohort experiments and tensor arithmetic. Continue to prohibit an unbounded VM, automatic causal claims, and an unrelated general-purpose framework as prerequisites.

amendments.subject: conditional-policy
amendments.replacement_intent: Catalogue experiments are activated by the user's blue-skies request. Speedup evidence is not required before implementation. The paired Cellerator numerical research tasks are part of this campaign, not a later promotion phase. Production integration and full benchmarking remain separate.

amendments.subject: stop-conditions
amendments.replacement_intent: Stop for unsafe resource behavior, authority conflict, invalid assumptions or unsupported instructions. Do not stop merely because an idea is unproven, API-unstable or not faster than CUB.

amendments.subject: cuda-v100
amendments.replacement_intent: Retain sm_70 and a capable CUDA 12.9 toolchain, explicit warp masks, legal synchronization and resource assignment. Permit alternative instruction compositions before performance qualification.

amendments.subject: communication
amendments.replacement_intent: Permit both compact summaries and demand-driven exact source/detail movement. Declare and later measure traffic rather than assuming every valid architecture communicates only compressed global state.

amendments.subject: experimental-retention
amendments.replacement_intent: The old CUDA lab retain-at-most-two rule applied to that lab. The new campaign preserves diverse mechanisms and meaningful failures; no fixed top-two funnel.

unchanged: caller-owned buffers, streams, capacities and counts
each repository is written only through its own reviewed task authority; the paired Cellerator experiment plan is proposed explicitly
preserve prior source, evidence and completed outcomes
frozen interface changes require explicit owner review
